1879064253.name: Sign of Power: Vigilance
1879064253.desc: Allows you to better see hidden enemies.

1879064381.name: Find the Path
1879064381.desc: Increases your movement speed, also affecting nearby allies.\n\nMovement speed only increased while out of combat.

1879102781.name: Guile Signal
1879102781.desc: Extends Guile fellowship skill bonus to your fellowship.

1879110461.name: Rune-sign of Storm
1879110461.desc:
<rgb=#00FFDD>Affinity - Lightning
Affinity skills will change their effects when you use an elemental skill (frost, fire, lightning).</rgb>

A Rune-sign will not only inspire, but infuses an ally with minor elemental powers.

1879117757.name: Onslaught
1879117757.desc: Multiple fast attacks, dealing direct damage.

conditionalEffects.description: The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks once.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 2 times.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 3 times.

1879136829.name: Improved Herald's Strike
1879136829.desc: This melee attack increases the effects of healing on yourself for a short time.  This attack will also remove Corruption.

1879139389.name: Stamp
1879139389.desc: Your attack enables you to break your enemy's concentration, interrupting his actions.

1879204157.name: Safe Fall
1879204157.desc: Avoid falling injuries (short of death) briefly.\n\nUsing this skill will break Stealth.

1879206077.name: Burst of Energy
1879206077.desc: Removes all cases of: poison, fear, wound, and disease

1879212093.name: Frosty Beverage
1879212093.desc: Frostily delicious! Warning: It's got a bit of a kick.

1879213885.name: A Slight Sting (Ranged)
1879213885.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's rear left leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879215037.name: Good Map to Grimwood
1879215037.desc: A well drawn and detailed map to Grimwood.

1879218621.name: Improved Chord of Salvation
1879218621.desc: Instantly heals an ally's Morale, applying a small heal to their Fellowship.

conditionalEffects.description: Chord of Salvation will grant your target 1% of their Max Morale for every nearby ally.

1879227837.name: Ring of Shadow
1879227837.desc: Harness the power of Shadow to provide a powerful defensive boon to an ally without a ring.

1879231421.name: Ranged Mighty Blow
1879231421.desc: A mighty blow that is difficult to avoid and deals damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879239485.name: Soft Bat
1879239485.desc: A bat made by the children, used for gentle whomping in a game of Brigand-bashing.

1879244861.name: Halt the Charge
1879244861.desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Riddermark Discipline your ranged damage is increased.

1879245629.name: Discipline: Red Dawn
1879245629.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff> Red Dawn</rgb>

The Red Dawn discipline focuses on runes that call to fire and destruction, calling the most power and potent of the Rune-keeper's arsenal to bear.

1879247805.name: Sundering Blow
1879247805.desc: A violent attack dealing good damage to a target. Critical strikes cause enhanced effects.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879302589.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Oath-bound)
1879302589.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879360829.name: Ash Frog
1879360829.desc: Brings out an Ash Frog to keep you company.

1879391421.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Elvish Warrior)
1879391421.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879396925.name: White Wolf-dog
1879396925.desc: Brings out a friendly wolf-dog to keep you company.

1879411773.name: Shattering Fist
1879411773.desc: Drive a devastating fist into your enemy's armour, leaving it broken and ineffective.\n\nReduces target armour

1879420861.name: Dusky Nether-hound
1879420861.desc: Summons a nether-hound to help you search caverns and other tight spaces.

1879421629.name: Turn Tail
1879421629.desc: Your companion can briefly disappear from before your enemy's eyes, becoming their least threatening target.

1879445181.name: Cinder Hawk
1879445181.desc: Summons a bird to keep you company.

1879447485.name: A Murder of Crows
1879447485.desc: You summon a murder of crows to tear apart your enemy, damaging and disorienting them for a time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with other potent Incoming Damage effects.</rgb>

1879454269.name: Return to Andrath
1879454269.desc: You're able to quickly return to Andrath in Cardolan. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879462973.name: Homesteader's Miniature Draught Horse
1879462973.desc: Summons a strong young draught horse to work your homestead and accompany you on your journeys.

1879476157.name: Sail to Lond Cirion
1879476157.desc: Navigate to Lond Cirion with nearby fellows.

1879490749.name: Unbridled Fury
1879490749.desc: Your companion lets out a terrifying roar, gaining an offensive bonus for each enemy in range.

1879492157.name: Scold Slackers
1879492157.desc: Returns target ally to activity from defeat. Only useable out of combat.

1879495357.name: Memory of Fellowship
1879495357.desc: A Memory of Fellowship can be used to inspire your allies, reminding them of their bonds and helping them to resist evil.

1879526589.name: Prepared: Wisp of Flame
1879526589.desc: Adherents of Balefire have learned to harness power as their enemy burns.

conditionalEffects.description: Flame Wisp, Spike, and Breath gain the ability to tier up the Ignite effect if present, up to Tier 3.

1879529533.name: White-necked Stag
1879529533.desc: Summons a white-necked stag to keep you company.
